name: Visayas Championship 2016
information: Registration fee(Inclusion: certificate of participation and raffle entry) is Php 200.00 for 1 event only, Php 300.00 for any 3 events, Php 400.00 for any 6 events; Php 500.00 for any 9; Php 600.00 for any 12 events and Php 50.00 additional fee for each additional event. Payment-first system shall be implemented before WCA registrations can be approved and included on the official list of registered participants. For participants from the Visayas region who are currently studying, kindly indicate on the comment section the current school institution that you will be representing. Mini 3x3x3 Cubes will be given away to the first 35 Registrants. Registration closes on July 17, 2016 so please pre-register and settle your payments on or before that date. Strictly no walk-in registrations on the day of the event.
